title: Overview
description: Provides a high-level introduction to rrweb, explaining the problems it solves, its core functionalities like recording and replaying, and the overall architecture of its packages.

title: Getting Started
description: Offers a quick-start guide for developers to install rrweb, record their first session, and replay it, aiming to get a working example in under 30 minutes.

title: Core Packages
description: Explores the main packages of the rrweb ecosystem in detail, providing developers with deeper knowledge of the recording engine, the player component, and the DOM snapshot mechanism.

title: Tooling and Extensions
description: Covers the auxiliary tools and browser extensions that simplify rrweb workflows, such as the browser extension for easy recording and the command-line tool for video conversion.

title: Plugins
description: Details how to extend rrweb's functionality using the official plugins for features like console logging, canvas streaming, and sequential event IDs.

title: Advanced Guides
description: Discusses complex topics and specific use cases, including performance optimization, storage strategies, handling of cross-origin iframes, and different canvas recording techniques.

title: Installation
description: Provides step-by-step instructions on how to add rrweb to a project using package managers like npm/yarn or by including it via a CDN.

title: Recording a Session
description: Presents a simple, copy-paste ready code example to demonstrate how to start recording user interactions on a web page using `rrweb.record()`.

title: Replaying a Session
description: Shows how to use the recorded events with `rrweb.Replayer` or `rrweb-player` to play back the user session in the browser.

title: Recording Engine
description: Delves into the configuration options of the core recording engine, such as data masking, event sampling, and custom hooks to tailor the recording process.

title: Player Component
description: Explains how to use and configure the `rrweb-player` UI component, covering its properties, API for programmatic control, and how to listen to player events.

title: DOM Snapshot
description: Provides an understanding of how rrweb serializes the DOM into a replayable format and rebuilds it, including the APIs for manual snapshot and reconstruction.

title: Web Extension
description: Guides developers on how to install and use the rrweb browser extension for Chrome and Firefox to easily record sessions without writing any code.

title: Video Conversion
description: Details the usage of the `rrvideo` command-line tool to convert rrweb's JSON-based session recordings into standard video file formats like WebM.

title: Using Plugins
description: Provides a general guide on how to integrate and configure plugins for both the recording and replaying processes to extend rrweb's core capabilities.

title: Console Plugin
description: Explains how to use the console plugin to capture and replay browser console logs (e.g., `log`, `warn`, `error`) alongside user interactions.

title: Performance and Storage
description: Offers strategies for optimizing performance and minimizing storage size, including event compression with `packFn` and various event sampling techniques.

title: Cross-Origin Iframes
description: Covers the setup and security considerations required to record user sessions that span across cross-origin iframes.

title: Canvas Recording
description: Details the methods available for recording canvas content, from capturing individual draw calls to generating periodic image snapshots.

title: Use Cases
description: Provides developers with practical examples and scenarios of how rrweb can be applied to solve real-world problems, such as bug reproduction, user behavior analysis, and collaborative browsing.
